site.name: Safarova
site.title: Safarova Tours | Discover Egypt
site.description: Discover Egypt with Safarova Tours: pyramids, oases, waterfalls and the Mediterranean, with local expert guides.

hero.title: Safarova
hero.subtitle: Explore the wonders of Egypt with us. From the majestic pyramids to hidden gems, we offer unique travel experiences tailored just for you.

toursSection.title: Explore Our Top Destinations
toursSection.subtitle: Discover Egypt's most amazing places with our carefully designed tours.

why.title: More Than Just a Trip, It's an Experience
why.text: We don't just show you Egypt, we help you feel it. With local knowledge, comfortable transportation and personalized service, your journey is in safe hands.

tours.name: Cairo & Giza
tours.summary: Stand before the last surviving wonder of the ancient world, meet the Great Sphinx and walk through thousands of years of history in one unforgettable day.
highlights: Hotel pickup and drop-off in an air-conditioned car
Great Pyramids of Giza and the Panoramic Point
The Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple
Egyptian Museum with an Egyptologist guide
Optional camel ride at the plateau
Lunch at a local restaurant

itinerary.title: Hotel pickup
itinerary.text: Your guide meets you at your hotel lobby in Cairo or Giza.

itinerary.title: Giza Plateau
itinerary.text: Visit the Great Pyramid of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure, then the Panoramic Point.

itinerary.title: The Sphinx
itinerary.text: Explore the Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple of Khafre.

itinerary.title: Lunch
itinerary.text: Traditional Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum
itinerary.text: Discover royal treasures and mummies with your Egyptologist.

included: Entrance fees to the plateau and museum

tours.name: Siwa Oasis
tours.summary: Escape to Egypt's most remote oasis: salt lakes, palm groves, hot springs and the endless dunes of the Great Sand Sea.
highlights: Round-trip transport from Cairo
Shali Fortress and the Oracle Temple of Amun
Swim in the floating salt lakes
4x4 safari in the Great Sand Sea
Sunset at Fatnas Island
2 nights at an eco-lodge with breakfast and dinner

itinerary.title: Cairo to Siwa
itinerary.text: Early departure, scenic drive via Marsa Matruh, check-in and dinner at the eco-lodge.

itinerary.title: Oasis & Desert
itinerary.text: Shali Fortress, Oracle Temple, Cleopatra's Spring, then 4x4 safari, sandboarding and sunset.

itinerary.title: Salt Lakes & Return
itinerary.text: Morning swim in the salt lakes, then drive back to Cairo.

tours.name: Fayoum Oasis
tours.summary: Escape the city and discover the natural beauty of Fayoum Oasis. This tour takes you to stunning waterfalls, desert landscapes and the unique Medawara Mountains. A perfect day for adventure, relaxation and unforgettable photos.
highlights: Cairo/Giza hotel pickup and drop-off in an AC car
4x4 desert adventure
Visit Wadi El Rayan waterfalls
Sandboarding and camel ride
Optional grilled chicken lunch + Bedouin tea
Medawara Mountains

itinerary.title: Wadi El Rayan
itinerary.text: Visit the waterfalls and the lakes of Wadi El Rayan Protected Area.

itinerary.title: 4x4 & sandboarding
itinerary.text: Desert drive, sandboarding on the dunes and a short camel ride.

itinerary.title: Lunch & tea
itinerary.text: Bedouin-style lunch (optional) and tea at the Medawara Mountains.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.text: Drive back and drop-off at your hotel.

tours.name: Alexandria
tours.summary: Discover the Pearl of the Mediterranean: Roman ruins, a legendary library and the sea breeze along the Corniche.
highlights: Round-trip AC transport from Cairo
Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
Pompey's Pillar
Citadel of Qaitbay on the site of the ancient lighthouse
Bibliotheca Alexandrina
Seafood lunch by the sea

itinerary.title: Hotel pickup
itinerary.text: Desert road drive to Alexandria (about 3 hours).

itinerary.title: Roman Alexandria
itinerary.text: Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa and Pompey's Pillar.

itinerary.title: Qaitbay Citadel
itinerary.text: Explore the 15th-century fortress on the Mediterranean.

itinerary.title: Seafood lunch
itinerary.text: Fresh seafood lunch with a sea view.

itinerary.title: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
itinerary.text: Visit the modern library, then drive back to Cairo.
